description: isometric pixel art building for a fantasy village builder game, bright vivid saturated colours, crisp dark outlines, a single isolated object on a plain background, part of a stone stronghold at the edge of a forest, standing directly on bare ground with no ground tile, base or platform under it, the gate shrine at its grandest: a chapel of grey stone and dark timber with a tall wooden shingle roof and a small bell tower, a carved wooden figure in a lit niche, many candles with bright steady flames, a stone path, flower beds with wildflowers and ribbons tied to a small tree beside it, offerings at its foot

references.usage: the first, smallest stage of this same building, chosen by the author: keep its stone, timber, roof colours, outlines and pixel style, and draw the bigger, richer next stage of it
